title: 2020 AMC 8 Problem 24
statement: A large square region is paved with \(n^2\) shaded square tiles, each measuring \(s\) inches on a side. A border \(d\) inches wide surrounds each tile. The figure below shows the case for \(n=3.\) When \(n=24,\) the \(576\) shaded tiles cover \(64\%\) of the area of the large square region. What is the ratio \(\frac{d}{s}\) for this larger value of \(n?\)

solutions.text:
For \(n=24,\) the shaded tile area is \(24^2s^2.\) Each side of the large square consists of \(24\) tiles and \(25\) borders, so its side length is \(24s+25d.\)

The shaded tiles cover \(64\%=\dfrac{16}{25}\) of the large square, so \[ \dfrac{24^2s^2}{(24s+25d)^2}=\dfrac{16}{25}. \] Taking positive square roots gives \(\dfrac{24s}{24s+25d}=\dfrac{4}{5}.\)

Thus \(120s=96s+100d,\) so \(24s=100d\) and \(\dfrac{d}{s}=\dfrac{6}{25}.\)

Thus, the correct answer is A.
